Petitions for rehearing denied.

Justice Blackmun dissents from the denial of rehearing. He would grant the petitions for rehearing, grant the petitions for certiorari, and vacate petitioners’ death sentences. See Callins v. Collins, 510 U. S. 1141, 1143 (1994).
